name: Data-Beam Business Solution
notes:
a leading system integrator and internet
service provider specializing in radio and fiber
technology for both wireless and wired connectivity
solutions. It took the company 6 years to establish
itself as a provider of these services. Data-beam
team is composed of  multiple last mile partners working together
hand in hand to meet clients’ demands. We are
packed with experienced professionals dedicated
to helping both homes and businesses stay
connected through installation, troubleshooting,
and ongoing support. We specialize in industrial
automation and are now providing internet services
in the Mindanao Region of the Philippines. We are
currently a partner of the DICT in both Lanao Del
Sur and Norte. Other than that, Data-Beam services
extend to remote areas including Bukidonon,
Sarangani, and Davao provinces. Our focus is to
bridge the gap between industrial systems,
hardware, and software programming. If you are
interested in learning more about how Data-Beam can
help you connect to the world, contact us.
